snapshot.text: Public Health Secretariat (SESAL) alongside the social security institute IHSS, in a deep crisis of hospitals and medicines. The new president, Nasry Asfura, took charge of the Health Secretariat himself in January 2026.

minister.name: Nasry Asfura
minister.role: President, directly heading the Health Secretariat

priorities.title: Health emergency roadmap
priorities.text: A roadmap to tackle the health emergency, with a promise to transform public health in two years.

priorities.title: Surgery backlog and medicines
priorities.text: The secretariat reports 4,000 operations and new medicine purchases.
